remote.title: Mi TV
remote.not_connected: Not connected · tap to choose a TV

connect.title: Connect to Mi TV
connect.none_found: No Mi TV found yet. Make sure your phone and TV are on the same Wi-Fi, or enter the TV's IP address.
connect.ip_hint: Find it on the TV under Settings → Network → Wi-Fi.

pair.title: Pair with your TV
pair.intro: This TV ({{host}}) doesn't have Xiaomi's MiLink service, so Mi Remote uses the Android TV remote service instead. That needs a one-time pairing.
pair.requesting: Asking the TV for a pairing code…
pair.enter_code: Enter the 6-character code shown on your TV
pair.error_wrong_code: That code didn't work. Enter the code now shown on the TV.
pair.error_rejected: The TV didn't accept the pairing. Try again, and enter the code before it disappears from the TV.
pair.error_connection: Lost the connection to the TV while pairing.
pair.error_certificate: Couldn't create the pairing key on this phone.
pair.hint: You only need to do this once per TV. If it keeps failing, on the TV open Settings → Apps → See all apps → Show system apps → Android TV Remote Service, and clear its storage.
